service_name: Water Supply & Sewerage Complaint Resolution (CMWSSB Citizen's Charter)
sub_service: Water meter, service line/distribution/transmission leakage, contaminated water, no-water-supply, hand pump repair, sewer blockage, water tanker, septic tank clearance
problem_type: Water meter defect, pipeline leakage, contaminated water, no/low water supply, hand pump breakdown, sewer line blockage, house sewer block, need for water tanker or septic tank clearance
municipality: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB / Chennai Metrowater)
department: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB)
authority: Depot Engineer / Senior Accounts Officer (via 24x7 Complaint Cell)
description: CMWSSB's own Citizen's Charter page publishes a real, detailed, numeric SLA table for water supply and sewerage services -- comparable in richness to Jaipur's charter. Covers meter replacement (7 days), service-line leakage (3 days), distribution-main leakage (5 days), transmission-main leakage (7 days), contaminated water (7 days if source is easily identified, 15 days if unclear), no/low water supply (5 days), hand pump repair (2 days), India Mark pump repair (5 days), sewer main blockage (4 days), house sewer block (2 days), sewer line repair/renewal (20 days), water tanker delivery (24-48 hours from booking, non-emergency), and septic tank clearance (10 days from booking). Separately, CMWSSB's complaint-redressal page confirms complaints are relayed to the responsible Depot Engineer/Senior Accounts Officer by SMS within a maximum of 3 minutes of being lodged online -- an internal-handoff commitment, not the resolution time itself.
procedure: Lodge a complaint online (cms-cmwssb.tn.gov.in), by phone to the 24x7 Complaint Cell, or in person at the nearest of CMWSSB's 161 Depot/Area Offices. The complaint is SMS-relayed to the responsible Depot Engineer/Senior Accounts Officer within 3 minutes.
sla: Replacement of defective Water Meter: 7 days. Service line leakage: 3 days. Distribution Main leakage: 5 days. Transmission Main leakage: 7 days. Contaminated water (source easily identified): 7 days; (source unclear): 15 days. Attending No Water Supply/Defective Water Supply: 5 days. Hand pump repair: 2 days. India Mark pump repair: 5 days. Sewer Line (Mains) blockage: 4 days. House Sewer Block: 2 days. Repair to damaged Sewer Line/Renewal: 20 days. Water tanker supply (non-emergency): 24-48 hours from booking. Septic tank clearance: 10 days from booking.
expected_response_time: 3 minutes (internal SMS handoff from online complaint to Depot Engineer/Senior Accounts Officer, not a resolution time)
expected_resolution_time: 2 to 20 days depending on category (see sla field for the full per-service breakdown).
complaint_channel: In person: any of 161 Depot/Area Offices
contact_information: Complaint Cell (24x7): +044-4567 4567. National Helpline: 14420. Toll-free: 1916. Phone: 044-2845 1300.
escalation_procedure: Public grievance redressal open-house meetings are conducted on every 2nd Saturday, 10:00 AM-1:00 PM, at all 15 area offices.
